# Hansha Tradecom Pvt. Ltd.

> Bulk supplier and exporter of raw rice bran, de-oiled rice bran (DORB), rice DDGS, corn DDGS, broken rice, paddy husk and industrial grain packaging from Strand Road, Kolkata since 2003.

## Sourcing & Freight Corridors
- **Primary Mill-Gate Sourcing**: Burdwan, Midnapore, Hooghly, Birbhum & Bihar Rice Belt
- **Maritime Export Ports**: Kolkata Dock System (Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port) & Haldia Deepwater Terminal
- **Logistics**: Direct mill-to-rake freight, calibrated weighbridge verification, and NABL-accredited batch Certificates of Analysis (COA).

## Product Specifications & HSN Codes

### 1. Raw Rice Bran (HSN: 2302 2020)
- **Category**: Feed Ingredient / Solvent Oil Extraction
- **Typical Assays**: 99% Purity, 12-14% Crude Oil / Fat content, Max 10% Moisture, Max 8% Sand/Silica.
- **Applications**: Rice bran oil expelling, cattle feed, and animal nutrition formulations.

### 2. De-Oiled Rice Bran / DORB (HSN: 2302 2010)
- **Category**: Feed Ingredient
- **Typical Assays**: 14-16% Protein, Max 1.5% Residual Oil, Max 10% Moisture, 12-14% Crude Fibre.
- **Applications**: High-fibre protein meal for poultry, cattle, and aquaculture feeds.

### 3. Dry Rice DDGS (HSN: 2302)
- **Category**: High-Protein Distillers Grains
- **Typical Assays**: 28-30% Crude Protein, 4-6% Fat, Max 10% Moisture.
- **Applications**: Dairy cattle rations, poultry feed formulation, and aqua feed.

### 4. Corn DDGS (HSN: 2302 1090)
- **Category**: Yellow Grade Maize Distillers Grains
- **Typical Assays**: 20-24% Crude Protein, High Energy supplement.
- **Applications**: Commercial livestock and poultry feed blends.

### 5. Broken Rice (HSN: 1006)
- **Category**: Food Grain / Industrial Processing
- **Typical Assays**: 99% Sortex Clean, Food Grade, 100% Broken Grain.
- **Applications**: Starch manufacturing, poultry feed, brewery adjuncts, and food processing.

### 6. Paddy Husk (HSN: 1213)
- **Category**: Biomass Fuel & Industrial Insulation
- **Typical Assays**: Low Moisture, High Calorific Value, Export Grade.
- **Applications**: Industrial boiler fuel, biomass power generation, and refractory insulation.

### 7. HDPE / PP Rice Bags (HSN: 6305)
- **Category**: Grain Packaging
- **Specifications**: 5 kg to 50 kg capacity woven sacks, laminated/unlaminated, custom branding print.

### 8. Jute Gunny Bags (HSN: 6305)
- **Category**: Eco-friendly Grain Packaging
- **Specifications**: 50 kg standard A-Twill & B-Twill natural jute bags from Bengal mills.
